decisions.reason: As a cutting and creasing finisher it remains close to the firm's core postpress know-how, so the firm can continue learning from installations and improving it through existing service and application capabilities.

The sheet preparation module builds directly on the firm's established workflow and finishing knowledge, which gives high absorptive capacity and makes continued commercialization and refinement likely.

The B2-format multifinisher is both strategically important and strongly related to the firm's existing portfolio, so management is likely to keep backing it in line with its automation-oriented direction.
The hybrid saddle stitcher fits the firm's long-standing booklet making and binding competences, allowing it to support, adapt, and sell the product without major capability gaps.
The folding add-on unit is tightly connected to the installed base and already had a concrete customer application, which reduces uncertainty and favors retaining it on the market.
